sv.title: Tidigare ministern vill slopa Arlandaavgiften: ”Mycket billigare”
sv.summary: Stationsavgiften på Arlanda central borde slopas så att det blir billigare att ta sig till flygplatsen. Det tycker politikerveteranen och tidigare Arlandasamordnaren Peter Norman.

en.title: Former minister wants to scrap Arlanda charge: "Much cheaper"
en.summary: The station charge at Arlanda Central should be scrapped so that it becomes cheaper to get to the airport. That is the view of veteran politician and former Arlanda coordinator Peter Norman.
